title: CPU reads a copy-written host-visible buffer after a fence wait with no TRANSFER -> HOST barrier
expected_finding: vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer writes color_readback (TRANSFER_WRITE) and the host reads its mapped memory after vkWaitForFences, but no dependency with dstStageMask HOST / dstAccessMask HOST_READ makes the copy's writes available to the host (the fence only orders execution)
